title: Sandbar Serenade
meta_description: Sandbar Serenade blends beachside ease with pool \& tennis perks on Panama City Beach's quieter west end.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Sandbar Serenade, where sun-drenched beach days and easy coastal living come together on the peaceful west end of Panama City Beach. Just minutes from the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters, this bright, open-concept condo offers the perfect balance of relaxation, recreation, and convenience---ideal for families and friends looking to stay close to the action while enjoying a more laid-back stretch of the shoreline.

Inside, the living space feels airy and inviting, designed for connection after long days in the sun. The open layout allows conversations to flow effortlessly from the kitchen to the living room, where a large TV sets the scene for movie nights or catching your favorite game. The dining table comfortably seats four, with additional seating for four at the kitchen counter---making it just as easy to host a seafood dinner as it is to gather for coffee before heading out to the beach. The full kitchen is equipped with all the essentials, so whether you're preparing a quick breakfast or a full evening meal, everything you need is right at your fingertips.

Step onto the private balcony and let the coastal breeze set the tone for your morning. It's the kind of spot that invites slow starts and golden-hour unwinding. When you're ready to venture out, the beach is just moments away, while the community pool and tennis court add even more ways to enjoy the Florida sunshine without ever leaving the property.

The sleeping arrangements are thoughtfully designed for both comfort and flexibility. The primary bedroom features a king bed and a private ensuite bathroom, offering a quiet retreat at the end of the day. The second bedroom includes a king bed along with a twin-over-twin bunk, making it an ideal setup for families or mixed groups. A second full bathroom ensures convenience for everyone. With two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the home comfortably accommodates up to six guests.

Beyond the home, you're perfectly positioned to explore some of the area's highlights. Spend the afternoon shopping, dining, or catching seasonal events at Pier Park, take in panoramic Gulf views from Russell-Fields Pier, or escape into the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park for hiking trails and peaceful shoreline scenery. This west end location offers a slightly quieter atmosphere while keeping you within easy reach of everything that makes Panama City Beach such a beloved destination.

With an in-unit washer and dryer, resort-style community amenities, and effortless access to the beach, Sandbar Serenade delivers the kind of stay that feels both simple and special---where the days revolve around sunshine, salt air, and time well spent together.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips.

Panama City Beach is one of Florida's most welcoming coastal destinations, known for its 27 miles of sugar-white sand, emerald Gulf waters, and a vibrant mix of family-friendly attractions, waterfront dining, and outdoor adventure. Guests can spend their days exploring St. Andrews State Park, spotting dolphins on Shell Island excursions, savoring fresh seafood at local institutions like Schooners, or enjoying the lively entertainment and shopping at Pier Park. With its easygoing atmosphere, year-round sunshine, and endless blend of relaxation and recreation, PCB offers something for every type of traveler---from beach lovers and boaters to families, foodies, and groups looking to unwind by the water.

Local Attractions: Pier Park, Dolly Pirate Ship, Top Golf, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Russell-Fields Pier, St. Andrews State Park, Thomas Drive, Shell Island, Conservation Park, WonderWorks, Ripley's Believe It or Not, Camp Helen State Park, Frank Brown Park, Panama City Beach Winery, Aaron Bessant Park, Laguna Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note your homes comes equipped with a high-chair.

Parking Details:
- On-site parking is limited to 1 vehicle. One reserved space (18A) is located directly in front of the condo, with additional visitor parking available nearby.
- Golf carts are not permitted in this community.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit Number/BTR: 71894
